transfer.stem: Which notes correctly track the tent’s owners, the borrowed helmet’s owner and Leo’s learning?
transfer.passage:
CAMP EQUIPMENT NOTES
Amy writes to Leo: “You and I own the green tent. It is ours. Ben and Mia own the blue tent. That one is theirs.”
She adds: “My helmet has a silver stripe. The plain blue one is yours. You may borrow mine this afternoon; it still belongs to me.”
Leo replies: “I taught myself to mend a bag by following a written guide. No one gave me a lesson.”

options.text: The green tent belongs to Amy and Leo; the silver-striped helmet still belongs to Amy; Leo learned by using a guide himself.
The green tent belongs to Ben and Mia; the silver-striped helmet still belongs to Amy; Leo learned by using a guide himself.
The green tent belongs to Amy and Leo; borrowing makes Leo the helmet’s owner; Leo learned by using a guide himself.
The green tent belongs to Amy and Leo; the silver-striped helmet still belongs to Amy; a guide means someone directly taught Leo.

answer.display: The green tent belongs to Amy and Leo; the silver-striped helmet still belongs to Amy; Leo learned by using a guide himself.

explanation.strategy: 先标出每句的说话者和物主，再判断学会的方法；借用和查资料都不改变已明确的事实。

steps.text: Amy写给Leo，You and I就是Leo和Amy；ours指两人的绿帐篷。银条纹头盔属于Amy，借给Leo后仍是Amy的。
steps.reason: ours包含当前说话者；mine跟随Amy，借用不等于转让所有权。

steps.text: Leo说明自己跟着文字指南学补包，没有人给他上课，因此taught myself仍是自学。
steps.reason: 自己学习可以使用资料；文字指南不是一位直接授课的人。

distractors.reason: Ben和Mia拥有的是蓝帐篷；绿帐篷属于写信的Amy和收信的Leo。
原文明说借用后头盔仍属于Amy；拿在谁手上不等于归谁所有。
Leo用的是written guide，而且明确没有人给他上课；不能把指南当成直接教他的老师。

explanation.pitfall: our/ours与their/theirs要跟着当前小组；借用不转移物主，自学也可以查资料。
